title: Compact schema inspector + example-corpus toggle for quickstart screens
creator: Asha Mehta
description:
Goal: Create a compact, single-pane 'schema inspector' component for the quickstart that allows developers to: (1) preview example outputs generated from a JSON Schema, (2) toggle between a small example corpus (3–5 variants) and a single live example, (3) see inline validation highlights and suggested prompt edits, and (4) copy a ready-to-run SDK snippet.

Scope: Visual assets, product screenshots for docs, and a short animated microflow for the quickstart carousel. This ticket covers finalizing screen mockups, microcopy for validation states, and providing annotated screenshots for engineering and docs. Prototypes should include accessible color contrast, desktop and compact mobile variants, and a 'share example' affordance for teams to attach example outputs to PRs.

Non-goals: This ticket does not include implementing the runtime validation engine or the SDK copy generation logic - engineering tickets will pick up integration after sign-off.
updates: 2025-02-13 - Kickoff: aligned with PM on prioritization; engineering asked for a single-pane that can be embedded in the right rail of the console.

2025-02-18 - PM feedback: request to add 'copy SDK snippet' button and a 1-click 'Add to eval set' CTA. Added to attachments and acceptance criteria.
2025-02-20 - Engineering sync: agreed on screenshot breakpoint widths and how to annotate variant-specific assets; created ENG follow-up tasks for integration (ENG-2301).
